Reel Review: Superbad is an absurd and vile film. It’s a ridiculously raunchy comedy. It is also sadly accurate to modern teen life. However, there is usually something redemptive about even the worst movies and this is a story of brotherly love though it is buried under all the foul language and cringey scenes. That said, I wouldn’t recommend it or watch it again. It’s well acted throughout. The pair of Hill and Cera are splendid. Hader and Rogen are also excellent. Stone is a superb addition too. Each of the characters are utilized well and have purpose. The film is shot particularly well. The shot set ups and production design and costumes are all great. It’s nicely edited too (I watched the extended cut). I can’t say I had a good time watching it but I got through it. This is not one I’d recommend even though I can admit it was well made.
